Name: PinkStations Tilesheets
Author: PinkStations
Description:
[b][size=4]~PinkStations Tilesheets~
[/size][/b]These tilesheets were made in collaboration for my dear friend [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Novaphene?gameId=1303]Novaphene[/url]'s Sunnyfield mod! I am uploading the tilesheets for everyone to use if they'd like some cute outdoor and indoor tilesheets

For Farmers: This mod does nothing on its own, It is simply tilesheets made for modders to use in custom maps! 

For Modders: Feel free to use these in any maps you would like! Remember to add this as a requirement for your mod so it works! Please contact me if there's any tiles I haven't added that you would like to use! I'm very open to expanding the sheets for more versatility. Note, please do not modify or reupload my tilesheets without my permission (exception for personal use only)

How to Install:
~ Make sure you have a mod that is using these tilesheets (they don't do anything alone)
~ Download and then unzip
~ Put the unzipped folder into your mods folder
~ The tilesheets will now apply to the map!
